'''Rass''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of predators native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sakiya]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Saki system/Legends|Saki system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> They possessed hard [[Bone/Legends|bones]] that were a pebbled [[Color/Legends|black]] in color<ref name="MI:BS" /> and used by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] species,<ref name="CSWE" /> who were also native to the rass' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> to make the handles for [[Melee weapon/Legends|bladed weapons]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Sakiyan [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] owned a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] with a handle made of rass bone, and considered the blade among his favorites.<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rass were first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
